- `strict/TASKS.md`: a TASKS.md in the strict format (checkboxes, owner, thread IDs).
- `loose/TASKS.md`: a hand-written TASKS.md in the loose format a coordinator
  might keep (prose preamble, free-form bullets).
- `loose/threads/t-0002*.md`: a thread brief and report, for link scraping.
  The other threads have no files on purpose.
